hints.title: Recursive Upper Bound
hints.text: In preorder sequence, the first unused element is the root. All left subtree keys must be smaller than the root value, and all right subtree keys must be bounded by the parent upper limit.

hints.title: Global Index Pointer
hints.text: Advance a global index across the array. A node can only be constructed if the value at the current index is less than the active upper bound.

hints.title: Recursive Subtree Construction
hints.text: If index reaches array length or current value exceeds bound, return null. Otherwise consume the value, instantiate a node, build left with bound equal to node val, and build right with original bound.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Finding the split point between left and right subtrees with linear scanning takes O(N^2) time in the worst case.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Passing an upper bound recursively visits each array element exactly once in O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should demonstrate O(N) single-pass tree construction using bound checking.
complexity.notes: H is O(N) for degenerate trees and O(log N) for balanced trees.
